picks.name: learn-claude-code
picks.description: Bash is all you need -  A nano claude code–like 「agent harness」, built from 0 to 1
picks.reason: 按 s01–s17 把 Claude Code 式 harness 拆开：agent loop、权限、subagent、skill loading、context compact、MCP plugin。上周还在修 Windows 破坏性命令匹配。适合对着每一课对照自己怎么写工具和权限门。

picks.name: nanobot
picks.description: Ultra-lightweight, open-source, self-hosted personal AI agent framework in Python with WebUI, tools, memory, MCP, multi-agent workflows, automation, and chat apps
picks.reason: 自称小核心的自托管 Agent 框架：tools、Dream 长期记忆、MCP、multi-agent、cron 都在 nanobot/ 包里。这周刚把 transcript 组装从 agent 挪到 runner，IMAP 改成先拉头再拉正文。适合看一个还能读完的个人 Agent runtime 怎么接聊天软件。

picks.name: ouroboros
picks.description: Agent OS: the agent gets smarter on its own. We just hold the line: the grading command and expected result never make it into the success contract we hand it. Interview-gated, staged evaluation, budgeted evolution loop. MCP server, 13 runtimes: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Copilot, Kiro and more.
picks.reason: 评测合同和成功标准分开：interview 先打 ambiguity，评分命令和期望结果不进交给 Agent 的 success contract。evaluation/ 是机械→语义→多模型共识，evolution/ 有预算代数。这周默认装 MCP v2，还在修 Windows 上的 orchestrator 测试。适合看「Agent 自己变聪明」时评测怎么不被它背下来。

picks.name: headroom
picks.description: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 20% fewer tokens for coding agents, 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.
picks.reason: 给编码 Agent 做的上下文压缩层：库、本地 proxy、MCP（headroom_compress / retrieve / stats）。ContentRouter 按 JSON / AST / 文本分流，这周还在修 cache-aware 计价和 compress() 复用 detect。适合看工具输出怎么在进模型前被压掉 20%–95% 还不丢答案。

picks.name: graphify
picks.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.
picks.reason: 不用向量库：tree-sitter AST 在本地把仓库收成可查询知识图，边标 EXTRACTED / INFERRED。这周还在修 Go / C# / Kotlin 的继承边。`uv tool install graphifyy && graphify install` 就能当 /graphify skill。适合对照向量 RAG 看「问路径、不 grep」怎么落地。
